# Calculate Q1, Q3, and IQR
Q1 = np.percentile(mar_2019, 25)

IQR = Q3 - Q1

print("Q1 (25th percentile):", Q1)

# Define outlier bounds
lower_bound = Q1 - 1.5 * IQR
upper_bound = Q3 + 1.5 * IQR

mar_2019_filtered = mar_2019[(mar_2019 >= lower_bound) & (mar_2019 <= upper_bound)]

print("\nNumber of values before removing outliers:", len(mar_2019))

print("Number of outliers removed:", len(mar_2019) - len(mar_2019_filtered))
